monitor.aria: Demonstration vitals monitor for a synthetic patient: heart rate 84, blood pressure 128 over 76, oxygen saturation 98 percent, respiratory rate 16.

loop.heading: Four moves, one encounter
loop.sub: Every case runs the same clinical arc, then hands it back to you calibrated.
loop.cycle: Each loop tunes your judgement for the next case.

interview.title: Interview
interview.body: Take the history from a synthetic patient in plain language, in Turkish or English.

chart.title: Chart in the EHR
chart.body: Order tests, read a live vitals monitor, and document inside a real record shell.

decision.title: Decide
decision.body: Commit to a differential and a plan, and state how confident you are.

feedback.title: Calibrated feedback
feedback.body: See competence against confidence, with every safety-critical miss surfaced and cited.

platform.heading: A whole training programme around the loop
platform.sub: The learner loop sits inside a full clinical-education platform.

cases.title: Dynamic cases
cases.body: Generated on demand from ICD and DSM, so a cohort can never memorise the bank.

rooms.title: Multiplayer rooms
rooms.body: Run one case across doctor, nurse, and paramedic over a shared patient state.

progress.title: Progress over time
progress.body: Competence tracked as trainable, banded skill. No numeric score, no leaderboard.

institution.title: Institution analytics
institution.body: Cohort competency, remediation, and a fairness audit, aggregate and role-gated.

sovereign.title: Open and sovereign
sovereign.body: Open-weight models, self-hosted, with human-authoritative case authoring.

credibility.label: Grounded in published guidance
credibility.note: Every hint and every miss is anchored to a source, never invented.
